title: Liveness of the prefix parser
statement: Let $\alpha$ and $x$ be finite bit strings, and let $s\in\mathbb N$ satisfy $s<2|\alpha|+2$. Starting on the encoding that doubles each bit of $\alpha$, then appends $01$ and $x$, the prefix parser is still in a live state after $s$ steps.
replaced:
For all bit strings $\alpha$ and $x$ and every $s < 2\abs{\alpha}+2$, the
doubled-bit prefix parser, started on the self-delimiting pairing
$\langle \alpha, x\rangle$, has not halted after $s$ transitions.
